text:
pagerduty-bot: HIGH severity alert S-4212 triggered: unexpected public ACL on data-pipeline debug logs bucket (s3://redwood-logs-pipeline-debug). Potential exposure of debug traces and service keys. Pager: ava (oncall).
ava (oncall): on it, pinging sec-oncall.
sara (sec-oncall): joining. can someone paste the initial evidence?
ava (oncall): saw automated scan show bucket had ACL: PublicRead. noticed uploaded objects with names like: pipeline/debug/run-2026-03-17-12.log.gz and artifacts/service-account-keys.json (looks truncated).
ava (oncall): quick dump of head of one file (sanitized):
```
--- log snippet ---
2026-03-17T11:58:03Z INFO pipeline: start run id=abc123
2026-03-17T11:58:04Z DEBUG auth: svcacct=svc-redwood-ingest, key_id=AKIA...XYZ, token=***REDACTED***
2026-03-17T11:58:08Z ERROR uploader: failed to redact user_id=sha256:5f4d... details=...
```
ava (oncall): looks like some redaction failed and a few truncated key blobs were present.
navi? (typo) -- ignore, typo.
mike (sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) restrict bucket ACL, 2) disable public access block override, 3) snapshot current object list for forensics, 4) rotate any exposed credentials. I'll run ACL change now.
infra-bot: runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/incidents/s3-public-exposure 
infra-bot: recommended commands in runbook.
mike (sre): executing: `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-logs-pipeline-debug --acl private` -> done (exit 0).
mike (sre): also applied `aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket redwood-logs-pipeline-debug --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true` -> done.
sara (sec-oncall): good. preserve current object list: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-logs-pipeline-debug --query 'Contents[].{Key:Key,Size:Size}' > /tmp/pipeline-objects-2162507890.json`
ava (oncall): started copy to secure forensic bucket `redwood-forensics` with `--storage-class STANDARD_IA` to avoid charging overrun.
ava (oncall): copy command: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs-pipeline-debug s3://redwood-forensics/2162507890 --recursive --exclude '*' --include 'pipeline/debug*'`
ava (oncall): copy started, estimated ~30s.
sara (sec-oncall): product/infra question: which service account keys are in those truncated artifacts? tom (infra)?
tom (infra): checking ingestion pipeline deploys. service account `svc-redwood-ingest` has two active keys. listing now.
tom (infra): `aws iam list-access-keys --user-name svc-redwood-ingest` returned: AKIAAAA111, AKIAAAA222 (last used 2026-03-16, 2026-03-17).
tom (infra): we'll rotate both. plan: create new keypair, update pipeline config via feature-flagged rollout, then delete old keys.
sara (sec-oncall): do not delete until new keys are deployed and smoke-tested. create rotation keys in staging first if possible.
eli (support): any customer impact? I've scanned open tickets for anomalies. No customer reports yet but ingestion latencies might spike during rollout. I'll prepare a support banner.
legal-team: pls preserve all copies and chain-of-custody notes; do not auto-delete anything until legal confirms.
ava (oncall): forensic copy completed to s3://redwood-forensics/2162507890 (objects: 128, total 12MB). checksum artifacts stored at /secure/forensics/2162507890.sha256.
sara (sec-oncall): evidence review: of 128 objects, 6 contained truncated key blobs; 2 objects had hashed user identifiers but no clear PII; one object referenced a customer email in cleartext (support webhook body). tagging this as low-medium customer impact; we need customer notificiation assessment.
legal-team: start timeline and impact assessment. notify privacy as required.
mike (sre): stepping through rotations: I will create new IAM key for svc-redwood-ingest, push to pipeline via secret-manager rotation flow, enable canary, then revoke old keys. ETA ~25m.
tom (infra): prepping secret-manager change: creating secret `prod/ingest/svc-redwood-ingest/key` -> done.
tom (infra): deployed canary config to 2 ingestion pods (region us-east-1).
mike (sre): smoke: canary ingests ok, tokens accepted, no errors on K/V cache. Proceeding to rollout to remaining pods.
sara (sec-oncall): once rotation complete, we will trigger KMS key rotation for any envelopes that used the exposed key and update access policies. Coordinate with infra.
tom (infra): KMS rotation scheduled after key rollout and verification.
eli (support): drafted customer-safe-notice: "We detected a misconfiguration that briefly exposed internal debug logs. We are rotating credentials and investigating. No evidence of customer data exfiltration except a limited webhook body that may contain a customer email; we're contacting affected customers directly." posting draft to #incidents for review.
sara (sec-oncall): good draft. legal-team: please review before sending.
legal-team: reviewing. standby for PII escalation.
ava (oncall): runbook checklist updated: https://redwood/internal/incidents/S-4212/checklist (items ticked: ACL change, forensic copy, key rotation in progress).
infra-bot: creating incident incidence: S-4212, severity=high, owner=ava (oncall), sec_owner=sara (sec-oncall).
mike (sre): rotation complete: new keys active, canary and full rollout successful. will keep old keys disabled for 1 hour then delete after sign-off.
sara (sec-oncall): confirm old keys disabled now. tom, confirm pipeline metrics normal.
tom (infra): metrics nominal. ingestion throughput within 2% baseline. no customer errors.
ava (oncall): old keys disabled. snapshot recorded.
legal-team: PII review: one customer email present in webhook body in object pipeline/debug/run-2026-03-17-12.log.gz. recommend targeted customer outreach and internal post-mortem.
eli (support): prepping targeted outreach list. will coordinate with legal and comms.
sara (sec-oncall): next steps: 1) complete forensic analysis (24h), 2) run grep across backups for any other public ACLs (mike), 3) save incident timeline, 4) schedule full postmortem.
mike (sre): running audit: `aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[?starts_with(Name, `redwood-`)].Name'` then `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket {bucket}` across fleet. will report findings in ~30m.
ava (oncall): thanks team. handing off to night shift: sara will be sec-oncall lead; mike will be SRE lead. I'll update the incident bridge and leave notes.
sara (sec-oncall): taking lead for monitoring and customer coordination.
ava (oncall): signing off watch; reachable if needed. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: incident S-4212 acknowledged by sara (sec-oncall).
